FREQUENTLY ASKED

Good to know before you book.

Are all Stavanger Adventure tours private?

Yes. Your experience is for your own group, so pace, stops and priorities can be adapted throughout the day.

Which experience should I choose?

If you are unsure, send your date, group size and interests. I can recommend the best option based on your trip and current conditions.

What happens if the weather changes?

Weather is part of outdoor travel in Norway. Conditions are monitored and the plan can be adjusted when needed for safety and the best possible experience.

Can you pick us up in Stavanger?

Pickup details depend on the activity, but experiences are planned to make the start and finish simple for guests staying in or arriving in Stavanger.
